headlines.title: 10월 국고채 금리 , 전 구간 하락 …외인 8.5조 순매수

key_headlines.summary: U.S. CPI unexpectedly rose 0.4% in October, beating market expectations of 0.3% and raising the possibility of a Federal Reserve rate increase in December, with some officials considering a 0.5 percentage point hike.

key_headlines.title: Youth Employment Crisis Persists Despite Semiconductor Boom; Workers Under 29 Down for 50th Consecutive Month
key_headlines.summary: While manufacturing employment recovers driven by the semiconductor sector, young workers remain excluded from this recovery, with those under 29 experiencing 50 consecutive months of employment decline and one in four facing job-skill mismatches.

key_headlines.title: China Pursues Hydrogen Dominance Strategy; $800 Million Investment in Five Hydrogen Clusters Over Four Years
key_headlines.summary: Following its success in solar and battery markets, China is now investing heavily in hydrogen technology with government support, establishing five major clusters with combined investment of 8 billion yuan to create an initial market and nurture corporate competitiveness.

key_headlines.title: Government's 'Speed Supply' Modular Housing Initiative Fails First Bid; Construction Company Not Found
key_headlines.summary: President Lee Jae-myung's flagship modular housing project failed to attract bidders in its first contract, with construction costs 30% higher than planned, threatening the government's push to accelerate housing supply.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing a study in contrasts this quarter. Large conglomerates are riding a semiconductor export surge with shipments more than doubling year-on-year, with the top 10 companies accounting for over 60% of total exports. However, this prosperity is not broadly shared, as youth employment continues to decline and President Lee's ambitious modular housing initiative suffered setback with its first project failing to attract construction bidders. The government's economic policies face challenges balancing growth with inclusivity and housing supply goals.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea maintained its base rate at 3% in October while assessing the impact of consecutive July-August rate hikes. Over half of monetary policy committee members expressed consensus on the need for additional tightening measures to combat inflation. Meanwhile, South Korea's 2027 'super budget' proposes to dramatically increase spending while improving the managed fiscal deficit ratio from 3.9% to 0.1% of GDP and reducing national debt from 51.6% to 48.3%, though analysts warn of underlying risks behind the optimistic projections.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean stock markets showed mixed signals amid U.S. Federal Reserve rate increase concerns. The KOSPI traded flat while the KOSDAQ rose 1-3%, supported by foreign investor purchases. The decline in U.S. Treasury yields across all segments was driven by foreign inflows and safe-haven asset preferences, with foreigners making net purchases of 8.5 trillion won. U.S. stock markets fell as October CPI data exceeded expectations, raising the prospect of a potential 0.5 percentage point Fed rate hike in December.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor sector continues to drive South Korea's industrial strength, with domestic battery companies maintaining competitiveness despite Chinese price pressures through high-performance differentiation. BMW selected Samsung SDI and LG Energy Solution as suppliers for next-generation high-voltage battery cells in Europe and the U.S. respectively, with deliveries starting in the late 2020s. LG Energy Solution and Samsung SDI both secured CES 2027 Innovation Awards for battery-related technologies, and Doosan is expanding into European markets with AI semiconductor core materials. North American production bases are being established to enhance competitiveness with global automakers and battery customers.
sections.Real Estate: The real estate market faces challenges with the government identifying 354 fraudulent apartment subscription cases among 25,000 suspected violations, including physicians falsely posing as low-income applicants and filing false family registrations. The Korea Real Estate Board is strengthening customized consulting by development stage to prevent delays in redevelopment and reconstruction projects. Recent transaction data shows continued strong prices in Seoul, with several apartments recording three-year highs despite broader market concerns about supply and affordability.
sections.International Economy: U.S. economic data is driving global market uncertainty with October CPI exceeding expectations and raising the possibility of a 0.5 percentage point Federal Reserve rate hike in December. Multiple Fed officials have signaled support for additional rate increases, reversing the cuts implemented in 2025. The strengthening U.S. dollar and rising bond yields are creating headwinds for emerging markets. Meanwhile, South Korea-based biotech company Medfactor is pursuing global licensing opportunities for its pancreatic cancer treatment MP010, demonstrating 87% cure rate success in clinical trials.
sections.AI & Economy: China is rapidly developing AI capabilities while managing employment risks through government intervention, establishing emergency protocols as companies accelerate AI adoption that could displace workers in labor-intensive and low-skilled sectors. South Korea ranks 10th globally in digital and AI competitiveness, rising 8 positions from the previous year, maintaining first place in R&D spending as a percentage of GDP and eighth place in AI publications. AI agents are now automating HBM chip design processes to reduce development time and costs, while regional governments are reconsidering AI data center strategies due to limited local economic benefits and minimal job creation despite massive infrastructure investments.
sections.Others: South Korea's digital and AI competitive ranking has surged to 10th globally, up 8 positions year-on-year, with strong performance in R&D infrastructure and AI paper publication rankings. Various companies are expanding their AI and technology sector involvement, including physical AI platform company IL joining the Korea Physical AI Association and establishing partnerships with international bodies. Samsung Asset Management is expanding dividend distributions from its KODEX 200 Target Weekly Covered Call ETF based on special dividends from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, while Shinhan Asset Management's SOL 200 Covered Call series surpassed 550 billion won in combined assets.
